component.name: Doom Launcher
component.summary: Doom frontend and WAD library for Linux

description.p: Doom Launcher is a library for Doom engine games and mods, built with Qt 6 and KDE's Kirigami framework so it looks and feels like a modern KDE application, with light and dark color schemes. It detects GZDoom, UZDoom and other source ports as native binaries, AppImages, Flatpaks or snaps, imports IWADs and mods, tracks play time, and downloads mods from the idgames archive.

This is DoomedLauncherNix, a Linux-focused fork of Doom Launcher by Hobomaster22 (nstlaurent). The launcher concept, database layout and the Windows version are their work, shared under the GPL; this build is a native Qt 6/Kirigami rewrite. Please support the original project.
Doom Launcher is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, and it ships no game data — you supply your own IWAD, or use a free one such as Freedoom.
Repair library selection, mod load lists, IWAD imports, tag editing and archive downloads. Add tested x64 and ARM64 tar.gz and Flatpak releases.
Restore source-port detection and launch across the Flatpak host boundary, with typed arguments, host working directories and failure handling.
Complete rewrite as a native Qt 6 / Kirigami application:

ul.li: Modern KDE look and feel with light, dark and follow-system color schemes
The GTK 4 / libadwaita and .NET stack is gone entirely
Existing libraries keep working — the same database and file layout is used
KDE file dialogs open files on network shares directly
